audience: affiliate teams that run referral programs in Tapfiliate

useCases.title: Check affiliates and their open balances
useCases.text: List the affiliate programs of the account. Find affiliates, then check the open balance of one affiliate in each currency.

useCases.title: Review pending commissions
useCases.text: List the commissions, filtered by approval status or paid state. Open one commission to read its amount, type and payout.

useCases.title: Approve or hold a commission before payout
useCases.text: Open a commission to check it. Approve it so it can be paid, or remove the approval to stop a pending payout.

useCases.title: Record a referred sale only once
useCases.text: Look up conversions by external id first, so one sale is not recorded twice. Then record the sale for an affiliate.

useCases.title: Move an affiliate to another group
useCases.text: List the affiliate groups, then move one affiliate into a group. The move replaces its current group.
